task_description.overview: Generate and visualize the time–frequency representation (TFR) of a seismic signal using a sliding window Fourier transform.
steps: Load or generate the seismic time series data array and define sampling interval dt.
Specify frequency range fmin and fmax for the TFR.
Call the plot_tfr function with the signal, dt, fmin, and fmax.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Given a seismic time series array stored in `signal_array_path` sampled at interval `dt`, compute and plot its time–frequency representation between frequencies fmin and fmax. The figure should contain the time-frequency spectrogram and the time-series waveform. 
 Note: 1) Save the time frequency representation plot to {result_plot}.
